Add a Live Out-of-Core DuckDB / Parquet Layer (add_duckdb)

Source: R/duckdb.R
add_duckdb.Rd

Connects glmap directly to a DuckDB connection (DBI), table name, SQL query, or .parquet / .csv file path.

Usage

add_duckdb(
  map,
  con = NULL,
  source,
  lon = "lon",
  lat = "lat",
  color = "#00d4ff",
  palette = "viridis",
  radius = 4,
  opacity = 0.85,
  where = NULL,
  max_features = 100000L,
  dynamic_viewport = TRUE,
  id = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  legend = TRUE
)

Arguments

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

con

A DBIConnection (DuckDB), or NULL if source is a .parquet/.csv file path or data.frame.

source

A table name, SQL SELECT query, .parquet file path, or data.frame to register in DuckDB.

lon

Name of the longitude column (default "lon").

lat

Name of the latitude column (default "lat").

color

Optional column name or formula (~col) to map point colors, or a fixed hex color (default "#00d4ff").

palette

Color palette name ("viridis", "plasma", "turbo", "magma", etc.).

radius

Point radius in pixels (or formula ~col).

opacity

Point opacity (0 to 1).

where

Optional SQL WHERE filter predicate string (e.g., "intensity > 50 AND category = 'Sensor'").

max_features

Maximum features streamed per viewport frame (default 100000L).

dynamic_viewport

Logical; if TRUE (default), dynamically re-queries DuckDB via httpuv as the user pans/zooms.

id

Optional layer ID.

group

Optional layer group name shown in the GPU Layer Switcher.

legend

Logical; whether to display a color legend.

Value

Updated glmap map object.

Details

Instead of loading 10M–100M+ rows into R memory, add_duckdb() pushes bounding-box viewport filters (WHERE lon BETWEEN xmin AND xmax AND lat BETWEEN ymin AND ymax) and Level-of-Detail (LOD) sampling (USING SAMPLE or deterministic stride) directly into DuckDB's vectorized execution engine, then packs the resulting slice in C++17 (cpp_pack_points_xy) and streams the GLMP binary buffer to WebGL2 over the local httpuv server on every pan/zoom!
